svg.text: Choose the semantic metaphor first · Hiking + Running · review only
Built field markings separate a rugged trail blaze from a measured running track.
Contact marks show deliberate weight on rough ground versus a light accelerating cadence.
Motion notation contrasts stepped elevation gain with a continuous rebound profile.
Defining tools stand in: trekking poles for Hiking, a split timer for Running.
Purpose-built footwear contrasts a lugged boot with a low, light performance shoe.
The Cairn is repeated unchanged only to calibrate line weight, restraint, and 48px scale.
Only Family E uses footwear. No human form, anatomy, character, pin, heart, ECG, or lightning symbol is used.
